philosophy.wilderness_and_postgame: retain default Cobbleverse pools; add low-weight place signatures

evolution_policy.rule: A table lists families by the species first met there; the generator walks the Cobblemon jar's evolutions forward. A stage spawns from the level it evolves at (or the band's floor) to four past its next level evolution (or the band's top), and not at all if that range is empty. maturity[tier] of a family's weight goes to its evolved stages, the final one taking (tier - 3) / 6 of it, held to [0.2, 0.9]. Evolutions not by level appear only from tier 6 (a trade from tier 7), in the upper half of the band.
evolution_policy.retired: 2026-10-02: the band-minimum rule (level evolutions only when every threshold is at or below the band minimum; special evolutions authored-only) and its fixed stage splits.

placement_sites_note: A placed structure's grounds with a roster of its own (mechanism placement_coordinate_boxes, an entry's scope a site id). tools/compile_spawns.py lays a site's entries over its placement's footprint (data/placements.json position and size) widened by margin, less the path and the spawn-free zones, inside the sub-region holding it, and appends them to that sub-region's file on top of its roster. Grounded entries are forced canSeeSky like every land entry, so a site spawns on the open grounds round the structure and its sky-open surfaces (a tower's summit), never inside under a roof. Hand-authored; tools/build_encounters.py copies it through.

placement_sites.why: Poipole's home (NETHER_ENCOUNTERS.md section 4): the pack's own author put it at the Necrozma towers, both from Ultra Space, and its only upstream spawn rode the End's copies, which data/dimension_overrides.json switches off. The footprint (7480..7525, 316..360) plus 16 blocks each side is the tower's own grounds: ground y97-100 over x7464..7541, z300..376 by tools/ground.py, no water. canSeeSky stays forced (grounded), so Poipole is met at the tower's foot and on its summit, not in the shaft.

as the Dawn tower: the footprint (1156..1201, 7216..7260) plus 16 blocks each side, ground y143-147 over x1140..1217, z7200..7276 by tools/ground.py, no water. Two isles and two tiers, so a Poipole player on either side of the map has one within reach (NETHER_ENCOUNTERS.md section 5 question 8, recommended both).

heart.why: Lake Tilpey's open middle, 305 blocks from Route 7: 94.5% of the heart's columns are lake bed under y62. The owner, 2026-10-05: the lake 'should feel like a pokemon lake deep in life', so the open water is layered by each species' own upstream position -- Pelipper, Bibarel and Araquanid on the islands and edges (grounded, beside water), Gyarados, Veluza, Golduck and the Kabuto line in the water, Clobbopus and Grapploct on the bed (seafloor) as the rare, Feebas and its Milotic the ultra-rare -- none of them the shores' (north: Ducklett, Flamigo; east: Lotad, Wattrel; west: Surskit, Inkay; south: Corphish, Sobble), and the heart the lake's giants. Every water family here is in at most one other water table, and an earlier one (section 5). The Slowpoke line was tried and left out: its water natives in the Cobblemon 1.8.0 jar are salt only (tools/spawn_habitat_audit.py MISFIT)

marine_zones.status: authored 2026-09-26; compiled, not seen in game
marine_zones.clip_basis: data/regions.json marine_regions windward_deep: its landmass stretch (z2592-5200, x to 984; the south edge taken to z5215, the end of the 32-block cell row the zone boundary falls in, so no 16-block strip is left to the pack) and its border margin, carried on west to the world border at x-1024 across the Outer Deep's strip behind it, so no pack default is left anywhere west of Route 1 and the west shore
marine_zones.distance_measure: blocks from the nearest land sub-region cell (tools/compile_spawns.py marine_bands); the sub-region polygons were drawn to the coast, and over the 3,959 cells of this zone to z5199 that distance matches the heightmap coast distance within -20 / 0 / +41 blocks at p5 / p50 / p95 (measured 2026-09-26)
marine_zones.policy: exclusive_curated: the pack's inherited spawns are suppressed over every band box (tools/suppress_inherited_spawns.py --subregions)
marine_zones.access: Open water needs a Pokemon that carries a player on water (the owner, 2026-09-26: 'a player on Route 1 for the first time can't swim without a surf mon'). No data in the repo gates riding; ASSUMED from the rosters and the Cobblemon 1.8.0 jar and COBBLEVERSE-DP-v31 riding data: the earliest water mounts are a rare Relicanth at Arrow Lake (10-22, before Brock), Gyarados from a lake Magikarp at level 20 (the gym 1 cap) and Kingler from the west shore's Krabby at 28; water starters' mounts come at 30-36. So a first ride falls around gym 1 to 2, cap 20 to 25, and the bands are set to caps 20, 25 and 30 outward.
marine_zones.level_logic: levels rise with distance from land, one gym cap per band: shallows 16-20 (gym 1 cap), open water 20-25 (gym 2 cap), the deep 25-30 (gym 3 cap). The cap curve is docs/story/GYM_SUFFICIENCY_AUDIT.md's recommended 20/25/30 with relativeLevelCap 0 (modpack/config/rctmod-server.toml).
marine_zones.depth: deep-water entries carry maxY 40 (22 blocks under the surface, below the shelf break at y46): in open water the seabed median is y21 and in the deep y14, so 19 to 26 blocks of water qualify. Surface entries carry canSeeSky true.

bands.basis: the shelf within 96 blocks of land; measured seabed p10/p50/p90 y42/y54/y62 (tools/ground.py heightmap 0d9b5f1e, 8-block raster). Small, common coastal Pokemon, all at or under the gym 1 cap of 20, so a player on their first water mount meets nothing over the cap here.

habitats.intended_location: the Sundown Watch on Sunset Isle (data/sunset_watch.json): one activated Habitat Block, sunset_watch_dial_ward in data/habitat_blocks.json, in the dial's centre plinth at (1068, 138, 7492), keeping up to 4 alive within 14
habitats.level_band_why: the band of sunset_west (data/spawns.json subregions: 28-38, tier 5, basis route_05_erika_to_koga, cap 40), the sub-region the Watch stands in (data/regions.json polygons). The one entry above it, Drakloak at 45-48, is the place's nest: the creature the place is for, strong enough that meeting it early is a mistake (5-8 over the cap); rare, so a visit is mostly Dreepy.
habitats.why: An ACTIVATED Habitat Block (the den's and the orchard's pattern) in the dial's centre plinth, disguised as a chiselled brick. Every entry carries timeRange dusk, which tools/compile_spawns.py compile_habitat carries into the pool and Cobblemon 1.8.0's HabitatSpawn reads (docs/research/notes/habitat-blocks-underground.md section 1). Outside the dusk window (ticks 11834-13701 of 24000, about 93 seconds of a 20-minute day, read from TimeRange in the 1.8.0 jar) the pool has nothing to offer and the block spawns nothing.

entries.eligibility_reason: Dreepy: Cobblemon 1.8.0's own coastal dusk Pokemon (spawn_pool_world/0885_dreepy.json: ultra-rare, weight x5 at dusk, levels 2-27, #cobblemon:is_coast and is_ocean). Here it is at the band's 30-38 and the pool's anchor, but only in the dusk window
Lycanroc in its Dusk form (spawn_pool_world/0745_lycanroc.json 'lycanroc dusk', timeRange dusk): the sunset dog. A final stage from Rockruff at 25, so it spawns over 30-38

Drakloak, the nest's elder: the middle of the Dreepy line (stock levels 50-55, dusk x5), here 45-48 so that it is the next leg's cap (45) and not the one after. Above the tier-5 cap (40); a party that meets it early is out of its depth. Rare: weight 2 of 32, one spawn in sixteen

habitats.intended_location: the Sundown Watch on Sunset Isle (data/sunset_watch.json): one activated Habitat Block, sunset_watch_mast_ward in data/habitat_blocks.json, in the lamp mast's second log at (1082, 139, 7483), keeping up to 3 alive within 12
habitats.level_band_why: the band of sunset_west (data/spawns.json subregions: 28-38, tier 5, basis route_05_erika_to_koga, cap 40), the sub-region the Watch stands in (data/regions.json polygons).
habitats.why: A second activated block in the mast's second log, so the Watch is not dead until dusk. Its own block and pool because an activated block counts what it has alive against its cap: day birds sharing the dusk block would sit on the cap and shut the dusk pool out. Day birds only (timeRange day, ticks 23460-12541, the jar's 'day').

entries.eligibility_reason: Swellow: the savanna's swallow, final stage of Taillow (22), so the whole band; it roosts on the mast
Swablu: the cloud bird, evolving at 35, so it spawns 28-38 with its evolution Altaria only at 35+

route_species_selection_note: Generated by tools/build_encounters.py from data/encounter_design.json (docs/mechanics/ENCOUNTER_DESIGN.md section 6): per route, the families in rules.corridor_roles (never a find) of every sub-region its corridor crosses (data/routes.json geography transitions), at most corridor_species_limit: every crossed table's water species kept, rules.corridor_rare_min of the crossed on-path tables' rare- and ultra-role species reserved (the owner, 2026-10-05), and the rest by chance times corridor length. tools/compile_spawns.py reads this list and does not choose. Do not edit by hand.

compilation.status: historical: the record of the uncommitted one-off that produced the former data/cobblemon/ files on the pre-rescale routes. Pools are now generated by tools/compile_spawns.py into build/datapacks/cobblers_spawns/, whose manifest.json carries the current counts; the box_assignment rule below is the one that tool implements.
compilation.box_assignment: sample the simplified measured route polyline every 4 blocks; a merged box receives a separate biome-constrained entry set for every geography interval its samples cross; outer raster boxes missed by simplification use nearest-segment assignment; recorded polygon-gap samples use the nearest adjacent subregion

rift_biome_note: The four Rift sub-regions' entries are keyed to cobblers:the_rift, painted to the lip by tools/rift_skin.py. They were minecraft:windswept_gravelly_hills, which after the biome paint exists only outside the lip: leaving them would have spawned the Rift's roster on the plateau and nothing inside it (2026-09-22).
